title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin holds at sixty-four thousand eight hundred eighty-seven dollars, up zero point eight percent, while fear and greed registers thirty. Hashrate at nine hundred ninety-three EH/s shows miner conviction even as sentiment stays suppressed.

US session delivered muted gains with price action pinned near the daily range. Mempool backlog at eighty-six thousand transactions keeps fees low at five sat per vbyte, signaling steady but not urgent demand.

Takeaway: network strength outpaces weak sent
